pr_title: Fix for `RuntimeNodeSelect` `selection_list` showing up as an orphaned node when editor is open during runtime
pr_body:
- fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/98999

The issue appears because the `selection_list` https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/194ddfd0c469bf1d554caf62f45a9736333d2c44 exists and is not a part of the tree, this solution destroys and recreates the selection list popup as needed instead of keeping it around.


[MRP from 98999](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17688863/control_orphans.zip)
pr_comments: How do you evaluate the cost of re-creating this list every time it's needed?

issue_context.title: Having a Control node gives 7 orphans in 4.4-dev4
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in `4.4-dev4`
- **Not** reproducible in `4.4-dev3`

### System information

Godot v4.4.dev4 - Manjaro Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue Oct  8 03:11:08 UTC 2024 on X11 - X11 display driver, Single-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Laptop GPU - AMD Ryzen 9 5900HX with Radeon Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

I updated to `4.4-dev4` and noticed that I have *7 orphan nodes*. I reopened the same project in `4.4-dev3` and there were no orphans there. This is the output of `print_orphan_nodes()`:
```
32631686465 - Stray Node:  (Type: PopupMenu)
32782681410 - Stray Node: /@ScrollContainer@2/_v_scroll (Type: VScrollBar)
32715572554 - Stray Node: /@ScrollContainer@2 (Type: ScrollContainer)
32749126992 - Stray Node: /@ScrollContainer@2/_h_scroll (Type: HScrollBar)
32816235887 - Stray Node: /@ScrollContainer@2/@Control@3 (Type: Control)
32849790321 - Stray Node: /@Timer@4 (Type: Timer)
32866567538 - Stray Node: /@Timer@5 (Type: Timer)
```
There is nothing in my project called `PopupMenu`. :man_shrugging: 
But after some trial & error, it appears that having a single `Control` node gives these new orphans.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a new project, add a Control node, save, run.
While it's running check the orphan nodes counter.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Open the project:
[control_orphans.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17688863/control_orphans.zip)
And when you run it, check the orphans.
comments: I wonder if this is the default Godot Tooltip?

Can confirm this happens only when the editor opens.

This prints extra stray nodes:
```
./Godot_v4.4-dev4_linux.x86_64 --path $HOME/Development/stray-nodes-test/ --editor
```

This doesn't print stray nodes:
```
./Godot_v4.4-dev4_linux.x86_64 --path $HOME/Development/stray-nodes-test/ --debug
```
